parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans expression, no documented facility/bathroom ban, no border document friction, and custody guidance requires addressing detainees by identified gender — a genuine traveller-facing positive. Hate-crime and hate-speech law expressly covers gender identity, with aggravating penalties. Against that, no comprehensive equality law, and the record documents that police often disregard anti-LGBT hate-crime complaints and attacks go unpunished — thin, unreliable recourse (tier-3/5). Social climate is strongly heteronormative with reported ostracism and harassment. The documented trans-specific violence (2009 kidnapping/assault, unreported) is old, with no recorded incident after 2014, so it is weak evidence about present frequency; the 2012/2013/2019 surveys are broad-LGBT and stale, so carry little weight. Nothing here is a universal-exposure or state-targeting measure, so this sits mid-band: elevated but not high risk.
